associations.rationale: The type gives the two scalar actions on separate summands and states that outputs remain symmetric, but it does not itself state the two-parameter formula for an arbitrary decomposed strain.
The type gives the two-parameter formula for a scalar part plus a traceless-symmetric part, but it does not itself assert symmetry of every stress output.
The type gives a decomposition and two-parameter formula for every strain in symSub, but it does not itself assert symmetry of every stress output.
